title: finding(ui): the kanban and calendar drag-write surfaces still discard a producer-marked refusal message
body:
Filed beside objectui#5210 by the seat that implemented it (session `01EuPCi56cnGyykygi3z9w4m`). Same defect class, different surfaces — left out of that PR deliberately: two more packages, two more test suites, and the ruling objectui#5210 implements names the console form.

## What

Two drag-write surfaces substitute a generic string for a permission refusal exactly the way the console form did, so a refusal the author **marked** as user-facing (`userMessage`, objectstack#9934) still cannot reach the user there:

- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx:687` — card move persist failure
- `packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx:436` — drag-and-drop reschedule failure

Both read:

```ts
toast.error(
  isPermissionError(err)
    ? tt('errors.unauthorized', 'You are not authorized to perform this action.')
    : extractWriteErrorMessage(err) ?? tt('table.saveFailed', 'Save failed'),
);
```

The substitution itself is correct and should stay — it is the same objectstack#3821 protection, and both sites carry the same rationale comment (cloud#864). What is missing is the opt-in branch: a message the producer marked is addressed to the end user and should be rendered verbatim, on any status.

## Why it is cheap now

objectui#5210 lands the shared reader `declaredUserMessage(err)` in `@object-ui/react`, already exported and already depended on by both packages (both import `isPermissionError` / `extractWriteErrorMessage` from it today). The change per site is preferring the marking ahead of the existing expression, plus a pinned arm each — marked renders, unmarked keeps the generic string.

`packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx:262` also branches on `isPermissionError`, but it selects an EMPTY-STATE KIND rather than rendering server text, so it is a different question and is **not** included here.

## Not a regression

Neither surface ever rendered a marked message, because the marking did not exist until objectstack#9934. This is unfinished reach for a newly landed contract, not something objectui#5210 broke.
